programme.desc: Action from the latest matches, including Stoke City v Coventry City, Middlesbrough v Birmingham City and Millwall v Preston North End in the Championship

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: When a bloodied body was found by two dog walkers in the leafy woodland of a Cheshire park in February 2023, paramedics could not save 16-year-old Brianna Ghey, who had been stabbed 28 times. With access to Brianna's father Peter Spooner, this episode follows the investigation that led to the convictions of two 15-year-olds for her murder

programme.title: Night Vision
programme.desc: News, sport and weather from across Scotland

programme.title: Champions: Full Gallop
programme.desc: After landing an unprecedented one-two-three and £860,000 in prize money in the Grand National, the chase is on for Willie Mullins to secure back-to-back British trainers' titles. Standing in his way are the Skelton brothers, trainer Dan and jockey Harry who are bidding for the double. Can the Irish maestro pull off another late charge and etch his name even deeper into racing folklore?

programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.desc: Ainsley proves that granny knows best by recreating a comforting gold top Irish stew made by his friend's granny and welcoming EastEnders star Jessica Plummer.

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: The chef visits Santiago de Compostela, meets pilgrims, and explores the local market. James later tries lampreys, visits a bakery to try Tarta de Santiago, and takes a mussel boat tour. He also cooks a seafood stew, T-bone steak, empanadas and rice with mussels

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James serves up a feast of food for broadcaster Nicky Campbell with help from chefs Emily Scott and Stephen Terry, and there are cocktails from First Dates barman Merlin Griffiths

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Great British Bake Off judge Prue Leith and actor Robert Bathurst chat to Alan, while there is an update on trainee guide dog Titch and horticultural designer Chris Hull shows how to welcome wildlife into gardens in winter

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: Sheffield Wednesday v Sheffield United (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents all the action from the derby in the Championship, held at Hillsborough. Both teams have endured miserable campaigns so far and find themselves fighting against relegation, with Wednesday's position worsened by the 12-point deduction they received for entering administration. United claimed a 1-0 win in last season's corresponding fixture thanks to a goal by Rhian Brewster, who has since moved to Derby County. With analysis from Chris Waddle and Phil Jagielka, reports by Katie Shanahan, and commentary from Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: The oat crop is thriving, but Liz and the twins must find creative ways to summon some rain with a heatwave showing no mercy. As the Royal Cheshire Show nears, months of hard work and preparation come to a head, but there's a race against time to make sure that everyone is fit to compete.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Vet James is concerned about British shorthair cat Nico as he has a limp in his hind legs. Fern meets cocker spaniel Nya as she enters the surgery for a scan on a potentially cancerous lump. Vet Amy performs a delicate operation on Border terrier Dobby, and cameras follow puppies in training at Bristol's Guide Dog Centre

programme.title: The Great Escapers
programme.desc: Stars from Coronation Street, I'm a Celebrity, The Chase and Loose Women compete to plan the best days out while on holiday, with three taking part in each edition. In the first instalment, Oti Mabuse, Dean McCullough and Barry McGuigan from 2024's I'm a Celebrity are reunited in Portugal's Algarve, with a sumptuous octopus feast, a showstopping dance with a local folk group, an energetic kayak adventure and a trip to Albuferia's party strip in store
